# Space Scope

> Space Scope is a premium multi-project management platform for agencies and product teams — sprint planning, kanban boards, time tracking, analytics, docs, sprint status reports, release notes and a full audit trail in one workspace.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Space Scope — plan, work, log and report from one premium surface for admins, PMs, developers and clients.
- [How to use AI for sprint planning](/blog/ai-sprint-planning): Practical guide to automating backlog grooming, estimates and capacity planning with AI.
